title: Radial spoke count
headline: Count the spokes
question: A set of small dark dots is drawn on a white canvas. The dots are laid out on straight radial spokes that all emanate from one shared center, so together they trace a star-burst of spokes: dots along the same spoke are very close in direction, while consecutive spokes are separated by a much larger empty angular gap. How many radial spokes do the dots trace around the shared center? Choose 3, 4, 5, or 6.
